title: Support-sensitive etale dimension bounds on strict local schemes
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $n\geq1$, $\Lambda=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$, and $S$ a Noetherian excellent strictly henselian local scheme of finite dimension $d$, with closed point $s$ and $\ell$ invertible [def-exc-excellent-ring], [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Put $U=S\setminus\{s\}$. Cohomology is ordinary small etale cohomology and supported cohomology is the right derived closed-support functor [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-pur-etale-derived-supported-sections]. If $F$ is a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $U$ and every point $u$ with nonzero geometric stalk $F_{\bar u}$ has closure in $S$ of dimension at most $e$, then $H^q(U,F)=0$ for $q\geq2e$. In particular, for every sheaf $G$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $S$, $H^q_s(S,G)=0$ for $q>2d$. If $S$ is integral, with generic point $\eta$, then $H^q(\eta,L)=0$ for every etale sheaf $L$ of $\Lambda$-modules and every $q>d$ [def-pc-integral-scheme].
